# hippius-mem

> An MCP server that gives coding agents a shared team memory. Notes are encrypted on the machine and stored in a Hippius S3 bucket. Every change is a signed operation.

Part of the Hippius docs for agents. Start at https://docs.hippius.com/llms.txt

The docs site does not have a hippius-mem guide. The installer for an agent is FOR-AGENTS.md in this repository. The human guide is the README.

## What it is and what it does

A local MCP server. Teammates share one encrypted log in a bucket they own. The binary is Apache-2.0. The bucket is ordinary Hippius S3 and is billed as S3.

There is a local solo trial that does not need a bucket. A team install needs a bucket.

## How to install

Follow FOR-AGENTS.md end to end: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thenervelab/hippius-mem/main/FOR-AGENTS.md

Never pipe the installer into `sh`. A piped run cannot see its own clone, so it runs `hippius-mem init` in the current directory. Download it first:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thenervelab/hippius-mem/main/scripts/install.sh -o /tmp/hippius-mem-install.sh
```

Pick one mode:

- No bucket yet (solo trial): `cd <their project> && sh /tmp/hippius-mem-install.sh --solo`
- Invite bundle from the team founder: `sh /tmp/hippius-mem-install.sh --bundle <file> --no-init-here`
- The four team values: `sh /tmp/hippius-mem-install.sh --no-init-here` (prompts on `/dev/tty`)

The installer wires detected agents. For the bundle and four-values modes, then run `cd <their project> && hippius-mem init`. Finish with `hippius-mem doctor --offline`.

Do not run `--solo` or `init` inside a clone of this repository. FOR-AGENTS.md says why.

## Credentials

A team install needs the team namespace, the bucket, the shared team key, and an S3 sub-token (access key id plus secret), or an invite bundle that carries them. Those values stay out of the git repo and out of chat. The config file is `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/hippius-mem/hippius-mem.toml`.

S3 keys come from the console: https://docs.hippius.com/use/console/s3
What S3 is: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thenervelab/hippius-s3/staging/llms.txt
